description: This file implements environment variable management functions, including getting, setting, unsetting environment variables, and manipulating environment blocks for different operating systems (Windows and POSIX). It defines the Environment class and its implementation, along with utility functions for environment variable parsing and modification.

classes.name: EnvironmentImpl
classes.description: Concrete implementation of the Environment interface, providing platform-specific methods to get, set, and unset environment variables.

methods.name: GetVar
methods.description: Retrieves the value of an environment variable, trying alternate case if not found initially.

methods.name: SetVar
methods.description: Sets the value of an environment variable.

methods.name: ParseEnvLine
methods.description: Parses a line from an environment block into key-value components.
